items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Juan Tizol) does not mention Bob Udakoff in his own turns. Udakoff is only mentioned by the interviewer as a third party who knew Duke Ellington and Juan Tizol.

ctx.x: Well, finally, they started the show, and he came in in the front, and looked bad, and he shook hands. I happened to be in the front seat, because they let two front seats for me, but he didn't see me. But he went and shook hands with a couple of fellows in the front, but he said what he had to say and whatever he played, he played. But he really was a sick man.
He had 103 temperature when he got out of bed to go do that, because we were sitting with him over at the hotel -- Bob Udakoff and Stanley Dance.
And I saw him, too, when he was at the hospital, and in the hospital, I went over there when he was leaving -- another time, that I saw him, he was leaving one of those big hotels in Beverly Hills.
